module.purpose: Provides the client-side application wrapper for App Router pages, supplying shared providers, page-status metadata, license gating, and nonce handling.
module.summary: This client component wraps page content with application-wide providers and conditionally enforces licensing. It derives an HTTP-like page status from special error paths, injects that status through a Next.js script, and coordinates server/client nonce values to avoid hydration mismatches while preserving content rendering.
module.businessContext: Supports Cal.com web page composition, licensing enforcement, and error-page status reporting. Failure can break shared application context, license restrictions, security nonce behavior, or client-visible page status.
